none: PAS CAM-613DB8: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Theodosius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius. AD388-395, (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads VICTORIA AVGGG. Reverse shows Victory left. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Die axis is probably 12 o'clock, weight is 0.9g, diameter is 13mm
